message.content: {"answer": "To upgrade your email plan, go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account, click the More Actions icon next to your current plan, and select Upgrade plan. Pricing depends on the plan you choose (e.g., Light, Core, Business, Business Elite, Studio Basic, Standard, Plus, Elite). For exact costs, check the plan details in your account.", "citations": ["897d73c3084173d159d367aa61cce9023498b0442335cec40e899aa310bcd14d"]}
